issues.message: The open menu of "Billing actions" is cut off by main > div.cards > section.card.clip:nth-of-type(1) (overflow: hidden): 3 of 3 options can't be seen.

The open menu of "Team actions" is drawn underneath another element (2 of 3 options hidden behind main > div.cards > section.card.stack:nth-of-type(3)). Its z-index only counts inside main > div.cards > section.card.stack:nth-of-type(2) (z-index: 1), which sits below that element.
